brief.topic: DAPA-HF: dapagliflozin trong suy tim phân suất tống máu giảm

evidence.title: Dapagliflozin in Patients with Heart Failure and Reduced Ejection Fraction
evidence.abstract: Over a median of 18.2 months, the primary outcome occurred in 386 of 2373 patients (16.3%) in the dapagliflozin group and in 502 of 2371 patients (21.2%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.74; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.65 to 0.85; P<0.001).
